Sam (FinOps): FYI customer Skylark disputed INV-0423. There's a ~38.8M token overage tied to their March migration window. Can we triage?
Marco (Acct Manager): They claim SE told them migration traffic would be covered. I have the customer message.
Priya Shah: Contract SOW says burst >4h/day needs written approval. No signed doc found.
BillingBot: meter_snapshot: commit=skylark-prod-4 period=2026-03-01..2026-03-31 total_tokens=178800000 reserved=140000000 overage=38800000 overage_charge=$11,640
Liam O'Connor: Runtime traces show elevated 5xx and retries between 2026-03-12T02:00Z..2026-03-12T07:30Z. Sending trace IDs to Sam.
Sam (FinOps): Proposal: place invoice on hold, open dispute D-1796789012, and apply provisional credit 50% of overage ($5,820) while we reconcile retries vs legitimate burst.
Elena (Revenue): Approve provisional credit pending detailed recon. If platform faults account for >25% of overage, reverse that portion.
Marco (Acct Manager): I'll inform the customer: invoice paused, provisional adjustment applied, we'll follow up with final reconciliation.
Priya Shah: I'll export per-route usage (chat vs embeddings) and run dedupe for retries. Link when ready.
BillingBot: export_ready: /billing-exports/skylark/2026-03/usage-detailed.csv (finance access)
Sam (FinOps): Dispute opened (D-1796789012), invoice INV-0423 status=disputed, provisional_credit=5820. AR ticket AR-9921 created.
Marco (Acct Manager): Thanks. Follow-up scheduled tomorrow 9am PT.
Priya Shah: EOD update incoming with CSV and dedupe results.
Liam O'Connor: Traces shared.
Sam (FinOps): TL;DR: INV-0423 paused, 50% provisional credit applied, action items: Priya (usage + dedupe), Liam (traces), Marco (customer comms).
